messages:
anya: Morning team :wave: quick async standup — dropping a short runbook.

anya: What I did: finished the eval harness for sable-13b-int8 and ran smoke against two promptsets (billing + chat).

anya: Blockers: seeing a weird hallucination/regression on the billing prompts after quant step — a cluster of outputs are adding extra charges that aren't in the input. Not sure if this is quant truncation or a prompt-tok mismatch.

anya: Today: triage the failing examples, open PR with better metric logs, pair with @leo for a kernel trace, and hold rollout for this model variant.

leo: saw the eval run in the dashboard. Can you paste one failing example and the eval metrics? :eyes:

anya: sending one failing case:
```
INPUT: 
"Invoice: 1x seat at $20, no taxes applied. Total?"
EXPECTED: 
"Total: $20"
ACTUAL: 
"Total: $24 (includes 20% service fee)"
```

anya: metrics snapshot: precision down ~3.8%, hallucination score up from 0.4 -> 1.2 on billing set. Full CSV attached to the PR.

sam: I'll try to repro on Dedicated with kv cache warmup disabled — might be a cache alignment issue. Ping me when you kick off the trace. :mag:

maria: FYI I see latency bump in the same time window on the console, looks like batching windows spiked for that host pool. Could be a scheduling artifact.

eval-bot: New eval run completed at 1765002230: sable-13b-int8 | billing_promptset_v2 | hallucination_delta: +0.8 -> +1.2 | precision_delta: -3.8% | run_id: r-2026-1765002230 | https://internal.eval/runs/r-2026-1765002230

tj: PR link? want to glance at the logs.

anya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-evals/pull/1342 — includes raw outputs, metric pipeline changes, and a smoke harness update. Putting rollout on hold (annotated in the PR).

leo: I'll grab kernel traces at 10:45 PT and look for any tokenization/attention boundary issues. If it's quant-related I can try a quick int8->fp16 comparison.

anya: added the failing promptset to the repo at /datasets/onboard/billing_v2.jsonl and uploaded example trace artifacts to the PR.

sam: Scheduling a 30m pairing at 11:30 PT — invite sent. I'll bring a repro script to run on Dedicated and on-host.

maria: Added a synthetic CI test to catch billing hallucinations (small prompt variations) so this doesn't regress silently.

tj: noted. If you want me to roll some test traffic to sandbox I can do that after the pairing.

anya: thanks all — will update thread after the pairing and kernel trace. :thumbsup: 

leo: thanks, will post logs here and link to the trace artifact.

anya: quick follow-up: if anyone sees similar regressions across other promptsets DM me — trying to determine if it's isolated to billing prompts or broader.

eval-bot: alert: related alert suppressed (investigating)

sam: got it, will scope other promptsets after repro.

anya: end of quick standup.
